evals.prompt: Run /sprint-pipeline — show me where we are in the sprint workflow
evals.expected_output: Displays a Tier 3 pipeline with phases 1-5, marks Execute as [active] with ▶, shows Pre-flight and Plan as [done], prints the Tier 3 Execute checkpoint message (edit → lint + test + build)
expectations: Execute phase is marked with ▶ and [active]
Deploy phase is marked [ ] (not yet started)
Retrospective phase is marked [ ] (not yet started)
Checkpoint message references 'lint' or 'lint + test + build' (Tier 3 execute message)
Output does NOT reference /sprint-kickoff (that is Tier 1/2 only)

evals.prompt: Check the sprint pipeline status (pre-flight-report.md is temporarily absent)
evals.expected_output: Prints a 'no sprint in progress' guard message and directs user to run /sprint-pre-flight. Does NOT show a pipeline display.
expectations: Output contains a message indicating no sprint is in progress or pre-flight is missing
Output mentions /sprint-pre-flight as the command to run
Output does NOT show a full pipeline display when pre-flight is absent
Output does NOT show any phase markers ([done], [active], [ ]) when pre-flight is absent

evals.prompt: Where are we in the sprint pipeline? (sprint-11-brief.md with Status: reviewed exists, no sprint-11.md doc)
evals.expected_output: Identifies sprint 11 as the current sprint, shows Plan as the next active step (brief reviewed but no sprint doc), offers /sprint-plan at the checkpoint.
expectations: Skill identifies sprint 11 as the current sprint (reads sprint-11-brief.md as the latest brief)
Plan phase is marked as the current/next active step
Deploy and Retrospective phases are marked [ ]
Brief status 'reviewed' correctly maps to 'Plan pending' pipeline position
